splitter: StratifiedGroupKFold shuffle=True; groups are source semantic families
calibration: none; report raw diagnostic probabilities and accuracy, not operational confidence

learning_curve.subset_rule: hash-ranked source families within each capability; at least one per present class

experiments.hypothesis: Family signal survives source-family grouping and outperforms deterministic keyword-family routing; word family head also represents the equivalent Phase-1 hierarchical family submodel.
Character features or combined word/character features improve capability routing on held-out development families relative to word-only direct classification and unchanged keyword routing.
In-domain lexical novelty and confidence can diagnose errors but cannot establish OOD precision/recall without rights-cleared negatives; no OOD model may be promoted.
Record counts overstate independent family evidence, and missing labels/negatives and source refusal semantics limit interpretation.
